description: This file defines the TransactionalResource class implementing ITransactionalResource, managing transaction states and coordination within Orleans transaction system.

classes.name: TransactionalResource<TState>
classes.description: Implements ITransactionalResource to handle transaction commit, abort, cancel, confirm, and prepare operations within Orleans transactions.

methods.name: CommitReadOnly
methods.description: Validates lock, sets record to read-only, and waits for transaction completion.

methods.name: Abort
methods.description: Releases lock and aborts the transaction.

methods.name: Cancel
methods.description: Cancels the transaction with a specific status.

methods.name: Confirm
methods.description: Confirms the transaction at a given timestamp.

methods.name: Prepare
methods.description: Prepares the transaction with necessary details.
